dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies such as the Forest Service and Department of the Interior, as well as participants in collaborative processes and resource advisory committees.
dimensions.evidence: prepared by the Forest Service or the Department of the Interior for a forest management activity on public land

dimensions.assessment: Changes the legal and procedural requirements for specific environmental reviews on public lands designated for timber or insect and disease treatment.
dimensions.evidence: limits the scope of an environmental assessment (EA) or environmental impact statement (EIS)

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are explicitly stated in the source text.
Amends the analytical framework for specific categories of environmental reviews under the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969.
dimensions.evidence: pursuant to section 102 of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to qualifying environmental assessments and impact statements for forest management activities.
dimensions.evidence: This section shall apply whenever the Secretary concerned prepares an environmental assessment or an environmental impact statement

Specific number of acres or projects impacted annually
importance_detail.rationale: The bill places procedural restrictions on environmental assessments and impact statements for certain federal forest management activities, limiting alternatives to action versus no action, which affects federal agencies, local stakeholders, and public lands.
